event.title: Alphabet closes €6 billion euro-denominated senior notes
event.summary: Alphabet closed an underwritten offering of seven series of euro-denominated senior notes.

amounts.label: Euro-denominated senior notes
amounts.quote: On November 5, 2026, Alphabet Inc. ("Alphabet") closed its underwritten public offering of €6 billion aggregate principal amount of euro-denominated senior notes (the "Notes") pursuant to Alphabet's registration statement on Form S-3 (File No. 333-296395).

facts.label: Series
facts.quote: The Notes consist of €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of floating rate notes due 2028, €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 3.700% notes due 2028, €1,250,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.050% notes due 2030, €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.250% notes due 2032, €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.500% notes due 2035, €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.875% notes due 2039 and €1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.250% notes due 2045.
